correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power, restriction to the smooth conic forces a unique non-tangent contact line and a one-parameter pencil with exactly \(q-2\) other smooth members. The dual-conic tangent-chord equation gives reciprocal multiplicative steps \(r\) and \(r^{-1}\) with orders \(n\ge3\); their Frobenius types are the split and norm-one tori. This proves the complete rational-cycle graph, the even-/odd-extension cycle counts, and the \(\varphi(n)/2\) parameter census. Exact secant/exterior counts and \(|\operatorname{PGL}_3(\mathbb F_q)|\) then prove \(\mathcal P_n(q)=|\operatorname{PGL}_3(\mathbb F_q)|\varphi(n)/(4n)\) in the stated divisibility range. Two direct-adjacency programs exhaustively reproduce all contact-type graph spectra over \(\mathbb F_3,\mathbb F_5,\mathbb F_7,\mathbb F_9,\mathbb F_{11},\mathbb F_{13}\), including base-to-quadratic lift of \(\mathbb F_3\). Finite checks support, rather than replace, the proof. Distinct contacts and excluded \(r=\pm1\) are essential boundaries.

originality.rationale: The most relevant primary predecessor establishes exactly \(\varphi(n)/2\) nested nonsplit-pencil conics when \(n\mid(q+1)\); this substantial component is already known. The new statement is the joint split/nonsplit arithmetic graph classification (including polygon-free cases), extension parity, and exact count over all ordered smooth plane conic pairs of contact type \((2,2)\), for every \(n\ge3\). Jow–Liang give geometric porism, Radnović–Ragas low-period pencil counts, and Wang transverse intersections, none implying this global all-period count from their stated theorems. Relevant published-result searches returned \((3,1)\) and \((4)\) contact statements, neither covering the complete \((2,2)\) claim. An equivalent classical unindexed calculation remains a genuine residual risk.
residual_risks: A classical all-length enumeration of split and nonsplit bitangent conic pencils could exist outside indexed papers, possibly implying this global formula after orbit-stabilizer conversion.
The 2020 nested-pencil counts strongly overlap the nonsplit rationally accessible subcase; that portion is not claimed as a new result.

value.rationale: A geometric contact stratum of smooth conic pairs naturally contains both rationally split and nonsplit tangencies. The exact rational accessibility obstruction, optimal quadratic extension degree, complete period graph spectra and all-pairs count are nontrivial arithmetic data not supplied by the geometric porism or special-pencil count. The universal formula \(\mathcal P_n(q)=|\operatorname{PGL}_3(\mathbb F_q)|\varphi(n)/(4n)\) is a natural exact enumerative invariant for every period and has a striking cancellation of contact-splitting factors. The result is not framed as a theorem about unrelated pencils nor as a rewording of the nested-pencil totient count.
